title: Do not ingest live worktree during publication
summary: Ledger ingest against a mutable worktree causes BLOCKED_GIT_MUTATION. Harvest publication must use immutable L: durable context and AppBuilder snapshot projection instead of live worktree reads.
retrievalQuestions: Why did ledger ingest report BLOCKED_GIT_MUTATION?
What causes BLOCKED_GIT_MUTATION during harvest publication?

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: harvest supabase projection or ledger ingest
doNot: use cross-agent-ledger live-worktree ingest for publication
